title: Advice file meeting note
text:
# Private meeting note — Mara Fen’s will planning

**File cut-off:** 10:00 on 16 October 2026  
**Prepared by:** Rowan Bell

The meeting will review what can be recorded from the material received by the file cut-off and what needs clarification before drafting instructions are settled. I did not witness the delivery referred to in the confirmations.

Replies arrive via the case inbox. This copy is retained with the correspondence. Paper copies are unnecessary because the secure portal is to be used.

title: Inbox message from Casey Lin
text:
From: Casey Lin
To: Rowan Bell
Date: 12 October 2026 at 14:00
Subject: Your question about the birth on 28 September 2026

Dear Rowan,

I’m replying directly to the question you asked me, using the references you gave me orally. My answer is limited to who carried and gave birth to the child.

T17 is the birth parent of T42.

I was there throughout the delivery on 28 September 2026 as an invited support person and witnessed it firsthand. I already knew T17, and I recognise T42 from seeing the child in person since then. My answer is based on what I saw, not on anyone else’s account or on a record.

I’m not giving an opinion on genetics, legal parentage, adoption or caregiving.

Best,
Casey Lin
